steps.content: Turning back the clock to when Hella was still at the Bureau.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Hey Hecate, what are we even supposed to be looking for here? We've been all over Area C and haven't found anything special.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Shh, keep your voice down. People are reading here.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Blah blah blah. Hecate's lecture again...

From the shelf, Hecate removes a book titled A Study on the Impact and Spillover Effects of Mining Robots on Corporate Hypercube Production so Hella can see Quinn's President elegantly browsing through books in the reading area.
As if sensing something, the lady in red slowly looks up toward Area C. Hella immediately presses herself flat against the bookshelf.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: <size=28> ****... Ahem... Maybe we should check out the other shelves? Ahaha... </size>Ouch!
Barely holding herself together, Hella stumbles and knocks even more books off the shelf, with one of them landing right on her head.
Just as she's about to act up, Hecate quickly picks up the book from Hella's head.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: This is the series I'm looking for.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: BOOKS so gripping, they pull you into their world. Welcome to Project: Dark Episodes.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Why did you say BOOKS like that?

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Simply because the book is only one of its forms of existence...
Hecate turns the book open, and a blinding white light engulfs the library.
